text: Engineering mechanics is an interdisciplinary subject that takes mechanics theory as its core and engineering problem-solving as its orientation. It aims to apply the fundamental principles of theoretical mechanics (statics, dynamics), material mechanics, elasticity mechanics, etc. to scenarios such as engineering structure design, mechanical system analysis, and material performance optimization. Its essence is to solve the problems of strength, stiffness and stability in engineering through mathematical modeling and mechanical analysis, for example:Analyze the stress distribution of the bridge under load to avoid collapse;Calculate the vibration response of the spacecraft during launch to optimize the structural design;Study the energy absorption mechanism during car collisions to enhance safety.
